description: The pie chart represents the distribution of '6 Matches' across seven categories, with each slice corresponding to a different frequency tier. The largest slice, labeled '6', accounts for approximately 30% (9000 units), followed by '2' at 20% (6000 units). The smallest slice, labeled '4', constitutes roughly 5% (1500 units). The chart highlights a steady decline in frequency from the largest category to the smallest, with adjacent categories showing consistent differences in size. This distribution provides insights into the preference matching frequency for Persona 6 across various tiers.
